description: This bar chart presents a quantitative comparison of three multimodal language models—SRPO-7B, GRPO-7B, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B—across four benchmark datasets: MathVista, MathVerse, MMMU-Pro, and Physics, with the vertical axis labeled "Score" ranging from 35 to 80 in linear increments and the horizontal axis labeled "Benchmark" listing the datasets in left-to-right order. Each benchmark has three grouped bars, color-coded according to a legend in the top right corner: dark blue for SRPO-7B, medium blue for GRPO-7B, and light blue for Qwen-2.5-VL-7B. For MathVista, the scores are 75.8 for SRPO-7B, 72.3 for GRPO-7B, and 68.2 for Qwen-2.5-VL-7B. For MathVerse, the scores are 55.8 for SRPO-7B, 52.9 for GRPO-7B, and 46.3 for Qwen-2.5-VL-7B. For MMMU-Pro, the scores are 42.3 for SRPO-7B, 39.9 for GRPO-7B, and 36.9 for Qwen-2.5-VL-7B. For Physics, the scores are 60.6 for SRPO-7B, 53.5 for GRPO-7B, and 45.4 for Qwen-2.5-VL-7B. The bars are not sorted and are visually presented with no additional emphasis such as shading or bolding, though each bar includes its exact score as a numerical label above it.
